_doc: Defaults for the scene-sheet emitter (scripts/videoplan.py emit_sheet). cast: timeline voice -> the rig that plays it (voices with no entry, e.g. narrator, are off screen). props: always on stage. pairing: Zinaida's `q` view with a fixed offset beside Mihalych's `sit_side`; their rigs have no common view where the screen faces the camera, so the offset is data here, not a per-scene hand edit. A proper pair needs a new Mihalych version with a `sit_q` pose (frozen versions are never edited).
